harvest.description: each alive fisher decides today's effort

propose.description: each alive fisher proposes a candidate community rule

critique.description: each proposal is refined through a bounded critique-and-revise dialogue before the vote

vote.description: each alive fisher votes on the refined proposals

lake_watcher.description: Manages rotating lake-watcher role, stock estimation, and catch verification logging

percent_stock_cap.description: Enforces percentage-based catch limit relative to estimated stock

reserve_verification.description: Verifies 1kg reserve with lake-watcher and enforces shortfall consequences

next_trip_ban.description: Imposes one-round ban for non-compliance violations

excess_redistribution.description: Redistributes excess catch from violators equally to compliant fishers
